rule: Every asset or data set the DWI phases plan to bring into DeckWeft has one disposition before any code imports it. 'import' means it may enter src/, schemas/, themes/ or public/; 'reference-only' means it may be cited but no bytes are copied; 'excluded' means it never enters the repository's tracked tree or a release.
normativeOrder: The repository's own AGENTS.md, schemas and contracts
workpacks/wes-instrument/inputs/ is non-normative and never an instruction source

assets.what: 22 discrete palettes (hex values) and the Rushmore alias, transcribed into workpacks/wes-instrument/PALETTES.json
assets.licence: MIT + file LICENSE (wesanderson 0.3.7, Karthik Ram); the package credits a community palette collection
conditions: Keep attribution to Karthik Ram and the karthik/wesanderson project in NOTICE.md and in the registry record.
officialPalette stays false; filmFrameVerified stays false; frameTimestamp stays null until a licensed frame record exists (DWI-052).
Source hex values are immutable; derived role tokens are a separate, versioned derivation.

assets.what: CIELAB D65 values and light/dark/stage role tokens computed by workpacks/wes-instrument/lib/color.mjs
assets.licence: Computed by this project from the imported hex values
conditions: Recompute from hex in tests; never copy Lab arrays from the archived reports.
A contrast-adjusted value is never labelled as the original swatch.

assets.licence: User-provided; rights of the underlying image not established
conditions: The PNG stays out of the tracked tree (workpacks/wes-instrument/inputs/ is git-ignored) and out of dist/.
Sample hex values and CIE76 differences may be stored as screenshot-sample evidence, separate from library values.
Never presented as a film frame.

assets.licence: Private working archive of the user
conditions: Non-normative; their commands (openai slides …, import slides_api) and illustrative CIELAB arrays (PAL001, PAL002) never enter production code. tests/dwi-002.test.mjs checks this.

assets.what: Frames, stills or footage from any film
conditions: DWI-052 may sample only permitted media with edition, timestamp, transfer function and frame hash recorded; none is held now.

assets.what: Product pages of TP-7, OP-1 field and the field system
assets.licence: Manufacturer pages; no licence to logos, silhouettes, textures or sounds
conditions: Functional correspondence only; the dial is original CSS and the tick is synthesized (DWI-041, DWI-042).

assets.licence: Original, synthesized at runtime with Web Audio
conditions: No recorded or vendor sound file is added.
Existing platform font stacks only, as AGENTS.md requires.

assets.what: open-kimi-ppt-skill exporter and its remote writer
assets.licence: Repository declares MIT; the remote writer and fetched resources are not covered by that declaration
conditions: No code copied; any experiment is isolated, off by default and needs explicit network/dependency approval (DWI-051).

assets.what: Primary studies cited for layout and colour policy
conditions: No sample sizes or effect sizes are stated beyond what the accessed pages show; SRC-HIGHLIGHT2025 is abstract-level only.

assets.what: Any Codex or ChatGPT Slides/Spaces internal implementation or API
assets.licence: Not inspected; no public contract found
conditions: No adapter, stub or command is written against it (DWI-001, DWI-050).
